hertz_force — DRIVE tacsim op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hertz_force(R: 'float', Estar: 'float', a: 'float | None' = None, delta: 'float | None' = None) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import tacsim; tacsim.hertz_force(R: 'float', Estar: 'float', a: 'float | None' = None, delta: 'float | None' = None) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hertz_force"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

Hertz の逆算: 接触半径 a か押し込み δ のどちらか一方から荷重 F。F = 4E*a³/(3R) = (4/3) E* √R δ^{3/2}。

Raises ValueError: a と δ の両方(または両方なし)、値が ≤ 0。
